releaseNotes:
🚀 Mega Fix & Update (v1.0.4) by Dhiraj:
• 📥 WhatsApp Status Saver Scoped Storage Fix: Full Android 11, 12, 13, 14, 15 support via dual SAF DocumentFile & All Files Access engine
• 🎨 Fixed Chip Navbar Visibility: High contrast colors for 'All', 'Photos', 'Videos', 'WhatsApp', 'WA Business' (never blank/white-on-white again!)
• 🔄 Enhanced Refresh Controls: High-visibility toolbar refresh icon + new in-screen 'Refresh Statuses' button
• 🎙️ Deleted Voice Note Recovery with In-Chat Audio Player
• 📄 Export Chat to PDF (1-tap document sharing)
• 100% Data Preservation: All your existing saved messages and media remain intact
